# Rio v0.1 automated acceptance evaluation

**All verdicts are automated independent sub-agent assessments. No human verdicts are claimed.**

The user approved automated verdicts for this acceptance gate. These are real upstream pull requests, not seeded fixture PRs. Each reviewer inspected the PR and executed independent upstream tests or reproductions in addition to Rio. Raw reports, exact commits, setup details, and limitations are preserved in the linked agent records.

**Conclusion: no-go.** The ten PRs cover three repositories and both languages, but only one of ten reviews was judged useful. The observed records contain no true positives, 4430 noise verdicts, four false-positive verdicts (two since fixed), and two independently reproduced missed regressions. Confirmed secret, graph and process-performance fixes improve reliability, but irrelevant mypy test diagnostics and skipped root TypeScript checks still prevent demonstrated standalone usefulness. Keep stable release blocked until improvements and fresh real-PR evaluation establish usefulness.

Conclusion reviewer: sub-agent acceptance_mixed (aggregate acceptance reviewer) (automated).

## 1. immerjs/immer #1345

[fix: skip patches of a draft discarded by writing its base value back](https://github.com/immerjs/immer/pull/1345) · mode `base` · review `d18d4909d79c72f3` · 32.861s · status `incomplete`.

Reviewer: sub-agent acceptance_typescript; verdict source: **automated**.

**not-useful:** No change-specific actionable finding. Root checks are skipped for a frozen-Yarn-install dependency mismatch; the explicitly trusted nested test project emits pre-existing TypeScript noise. The report exposes these limitations honestly.

Complete evidence: [agent-typescript.json](agent-typescript.json). Finding verdicts: {'noise': 51}.

- Automated code assessment; no human reviewer verdicts were fabricated.
- Rio ran offline without model endpoints, so triage, agents and verification were deferred.
- Yarn frozen installation completed successfully without modifying tracked manifests or lockfiles, but npm bundled hosted-git-info@9.0.2 differs from the graph expectation 9.0.3; Rio conservatively skips root typecheck and coverage.
- Explicit trust only enables the nested test project lacking a governing lockfile; baseline classification remains unavailable.
- Lint has no project ESLint configuration; dependency audit is skipped offline.
- A clean source-tree archive from #1341 base reproduced every emitted diagnostic verbatim; this confirms existing noise, rather than proving absence of other defects.
